name: Maryland
notes: Maryland supports digital ID in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open Wallet on your iPhone running iOS 15.4 or later.
Tap + and select 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Scan the front and back of your Maryland driver's license or ID.
Complete the face and motion liveness check.
The Maryland MVA will verify and approve your digital ID — approval is typically instant to a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan your Maryland ID front and back.
Take a selfie for identity verification.
Wait for MVA approval — usually a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Scan the front and back of your Maryland driver's license or ID.
The Maryland MVA will verify and approve your digital ID.
